verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms team scheduling features (round-robin & team scheduling, multiple calendar sync, conflict checking) and community corroboration that Calendly can check multiple calendars to find blocks where all parties are free, which underlies collective-style events. However, no evidence explicitly names or describes the 'Collective Event' type or confirms slots only show when *every* required host is free (as opposed to round-robin's 'any one host' logic). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Collective event type, its all-hosts-must-be-free logic, and hands-on/community confirmation it works as described.
